text: Grandson's staying with me, he's 7. He's got a few itchy bites on his arms and one on his ankle, I think midges or maybe mosquitoes from the garden, not really sure. He keeps scratching them and can't get comfy. I might be being silly but I read something about necks so I checked and his neck seems fine, he can look down at his toes no problem. I'm shattered and I just want to know if there's anything I should put on them or if I should just let him be till morning
